# Audo

> Senior technology partner for websites, web applications, automation, AI coaching, and product strategy.

Audo helps individuals and small businesses get practical technology work off their plate. The business is led by Aaron Hancock and is intentionally small so clients can work directly with one senior partner who understands the context, makes the fix, and can continue supporting the work without large-agency overhead.

Website: https://getaudo.com/
Discovery: https://getaudo.com/#discovery

## Services

- Website and web application management: ongoing care for existing websites, apps, forms, hosting, analytics, integrations, UX cleanup, and practical improvements.
- Website, dashboard, and internal tool creation: useful websites, dashboards, intake flows, internal tools, MVPs, prototypes, and supported launches.
- Automation consulting: help with repeat tasks, follow-up, scheduling, reminders, reports, documents, spreadsheets, SOPs, and tool handoffs.
- AI coaching, training, and support: practical AI use cases, prompt coaching, team training, privacy guardrails, tool selection, and AI-assisted workflows.
- Product consulting and strategy: customer jobs, product priorities, MVP scope, feasibility, build-vs-buy decisions, and next steps.

## Scenario Library

The site includes 100 specific scenario pages covering website and app care, automation, AI support, product strategy, and individual consulting. Each scenario page explains the problem, how Audo helps, the expected result, common questions, and includes a Free Discovery form that identifies the scenario in the request.

Scenario pages use clean URLs under https://getaudo.com/scenarios/ and are listed in the dynamic sitemap.

## Why Audo

Clients work directly with one senior technology partner instead of managing a large agency process, juggling multiple vendors, or carrying the problem alone. Aaron brings product, software, automation, AI, website, and operations experience across startups, agencies, enterprise product teams, advisory work, owner-led businesses, automotive retail technology, dealership platforms, ecommerce, powersports, RV, marine, marketplaces, internal tools, and customer-facing web products.
